title: Screen notch, dynamic island, and aspect ratio UI clipping
symptoms: Buttons hidden beneath camera cutouts or dynamic island
UI clipped on tablets with 4:3 ratios
causes: Fixed pixel coordinates ignoring Screen.safeArea in UI layout hierarchies

solution.action: Attach a dynamic Safe Area script that binds main UI panels to Screen.safeArea rect.
Use proportional stretch anchors for full-screen canvasses.

prevention: Test across varied device resolutions using Unity Device Simulator.
